state.task: Pick the ONE website/Google flaw that makes the strongest short Instagram audit video aimed at plumbers and HVAC owners (B2B): obvious on screen within 2 seconds, clearly costs this business calls, and fully proven by the facts below.
state.business: Valley Air Heating, Cooling & Plumbing, Staunton VA. Google: 4.9 stars, 1,624 reviews (main listing); second listing Mt Crawford 4.8 stars, 72 reviews. Real team photos on site (20+ named staff on team page). On-page SEO decent: homepage title and H1 name Staunton VA, separate pages per service.

verified_flaws.no_review_badge: Homepage first screen (phone and desktop) is a Trane manufacturer promo; no star rating or review count anywhere on the homepage. The 1,624-review count only appears on the separate Reviews page. Desktop top bar instead shows two big red buttons asking visitors to 'Review our location'.
verified_flaws.reviews_too_low: Homepage review cards (Google logo, 5 stars) sit in roughly the 5th section, about halfway down a 10,450 px page.
verified_flaws.slow_load: Lighthouse mobile lab test: performance 24-26/100, largest content paint 5.0-5.3 s (a comparable local plumber site scored 73, 3.6 s).
verified_flaws.long_form: Request-an-appointment form has about 16 input fields.
verified_flaws.service_page_no_town: AC repair page title 'AC Repair Contractor - Certified & Licensed AC Technicians' and headline 'Trusted AC Repair Service At Affordable Prices' name no town.
verified_flaws.no_location_pages: Only one combined service-area page; no individual town pages for Harrisonburg, Waynesboro, Charlottesville etc.
verified_flaws.second_gbp_neglected: Mt Crawford Google listing has only 2 photos and no visible owner replies, including a 3-star review from 6 months ago.

pick.instructions: Which single verified flaw makes the strongest audit video for this business, given the task?

criteria.no_review_badge: 1,624 reviews hidden: no rating/count badge on the homepage, first screen is a manufacturer ad
criteria.reviews_too_low: Review section buried halfway down the homepage
criteria.slow_load: Homepage slow on mobile (5 s, score 24-26)
criteria.service_page_no_town: AC repair page names no town
criteria.second_gbp_neglected: Second Google listing neglected: 2 photos, unanswered reviews
